$comment: ARC-06-S04. One sentence per check id per platform. The launchers (ARC-06-S10/S11) print these WITHOUT Node, so they are data rather than code, and their parity test reads this file. `default` is used when a platform has no row of its own. ARC-09-C270: a second cause of the same check is a named object inside its row (claudeCode.offPath), asked for with remedyFor(id, { variant }); it is not a check id.

git.linux: install git with your distribution's package manager (apt install git · dnf install git)
git.default: install a newer git from https://git-scm.com/downloads

claudeCode.darwin: install Claude Code from https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup, then re-run
claudeCode.linux: install Claude Code from https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup, then re-run
claudeCode.win32: install Claude Code from https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup, then re-run
claudeCode.default: install Claude Code from https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup, then re-run

offPath.darwin: add ~/.local/bin to your PATH with this line, then re-run (bash on macOS: ~/.bash_profile instead; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/troubleshoot-install): echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.zshrc && source ~/.zshrc
offPath.linux: add ~/.local/bin to your PATH with this line, then re-run (zsh: ~/.zshrc instead; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/troubleshoot-install): echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc && source ~/.bashrc
offPath.win32: add that folder to your PATH with this PowerShell line, then open a new PowerShell window and re-run (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/troubleshoot-install): [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("Path", [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "User") + ";$env:USERPROFILE\.local\bin", "User")
offPath.default: add ~/.local/bin to your shell's PATH (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/troubleshoot-install), open a new terminal and re-run

network.darwin: check your network, or set HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY for your environment, and re-run
network.linux: check your network, or set HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY for your environment, and re-run
network.win32: check your network, or set HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY for your environment, and re-run
network.default: check your network, or set HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY for your environment, and re-run

node.linux: install Node.js from your distribution's package manager, or use nvm
node.default: install a newer Node.js from https://nodejs.org/en/download

platform.darwin: a 64-bit build of Node.js is recommended
platform.linux: a 64-bit build of Node.js is recommended
platform.win32: a 64-bit build of Node.js is recommended
platform.default: a 64-bit build of Node.js is recommended
